name: Mento Brazilian Real
oneLiner: BRLm is Mento's reserve-backed Brazilian real stablecoin on Celo, issued and retired through the oracle-priced USDm/BRLm Broker pool.
collateral: Shared Mento Reserve: Mento's current analytics configuration classifies BRLm as reserve-backed rather than CDP-backed. Its backing is the protocol's diversified, dynamically managed reserve, not USDm locked in a BRLm-specific trove.
pegMechanism: BRLm is issued through Mento v2's USDm/BRLm Broker and BiPoolManager exchange. A USDm-to-BRLm swap burns incoming USDm and mints outgoing BRLm; the reverse burns BRLm and mints USDm. The constant-sum virtual pool prices swaps from the BRL/USD SortedOracles feed and applies spread, trading-limit, report-count, freshness, and BreakerBox checks.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Claude owner-ruling R2 Mento archetype application
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Owner ruling 2026-07-31 places Mento's protocol-reserve-backed FX inventory under the fiat-cash archetype umbrella, following the reserve-backed USDm/EURm precedent already recorded on cusd-celo and ceur-celo. BRLm is minted and burned as reserve-backed inventory against the shared Mento Reserve through the Mento Broker at oracle rates: there is no borrower trove, no position health factor, and no liquidation path, so cdp remains inapplicable. Under this ruling fiat-cash reads as reserve-backed cash-equivalent inventory issuance rather than strictly custodial off-chain cash.
